findings.message: orphaned awaitable: 'open' = Npgsql.NpgsqlConnection.OpenAsync/1(...) is obtained and lost -- never awaited, returned, stored or otherwise observed; the operation still runs (there is no result to release), its failure is lost, and a transaction / connection lifecycle call leaves the connection in a state nobody can finish. Await it and keep the result, return or store it where it is observed, or express fire-and-forget explicitly
